title: P≠NP Barriers OQ-01: Sound Axiomatic Formalization (Three Barriers)
description: Sound axiomatic formalization of the three major P≠NP barriers using opaque complexity class constants with axiomatized properties (no trivial solver). Formalizes Relativization (Baker-Gill-Solovay 1975), Natural Proofs (Razborov-Rudich 1997), and Algebrization (Aaronson-Wigderson 2009). Includes polynomial hierarchy and Karp-Lipton theorem. 28 axioms (3 eliminated from prior 31).

overview.historicalContext: Baker-Gill-Solovay (1975), Razborov-Rudich (1997), Aaronson-Wigderson (2009) explain why standard techniques fail to resolve P vs NP.
overview.problemStatement: Prove all three major barriers using sound opaque axiomatic complexity classes.
overview.proofStrategy: Opaque complexity class constants prevent trivial solver construction; axioms capture proved complexity theory facts.
